test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Three candidates, A, B and C contested an election and received 1800, 3300 and 3900 votes, respectively. What percentage of the total votes did B get (correct to two decimal places), assuming no vote was invalid?
solution:
**Given:**

A, B, and C contested an election and received 1800, 3300, and 3900 votes respectively

**Calculation:**

Total votes = 1800 + 3300 + 3900 = 9000

Required % = (3300/9000) × 100

⇒ 36.66 ≈ 36.67%

**∴ B got 36.67% of the total votes.**
